nodes.name: Save study guide to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Who is this for?
Job seekers who want a searchable study log of technical interview questions and clear explanations for later practice.

## How it works
Submit a question, target role, and optional draft answer through an n8n form. OpenAI creates a study guide covering key concepts, a reference answer, common mistakes, follow-up questions, and feedback on the draft. The workflow validates the response, saves it to Google Sheets, and sends a plain-text summary to your configured Gmail recipient. Each row includes a suggested review date three days later; this does not schedule a reminder.

## Setup
Connect Form Basic Auth, OpenAI, Google Sheets, and Gmail credentials. In Configure study settings, set your spreadsheet ID, worksheet name, recipient email, and an available OpenAI model. Create a sheet using the supplied column headers. Test with a practice question before activating the workflow.

## Requirements and customization
Requires an n8n instance, an OpenAI API account with available credit, a Google spreadsheet, and Gmail. Customize the prompt and review interval for your study routine. AI explanations may be incorrect: verify technical claims. Submit only questions you are permitted to share with OpenAI and Google.

Created by [SkillCopilotAI](https://skillcopilotai.com/), an AI interview assistance product.

## 1. Configure before testing
Connect Form Basic Auth and keep access private. Set spreadsheetId, worksheetName, recipientEmail and openaiModel in Configure study settings. The recipient is fixed by the owner, never taken from public form input. Import sheet-headers.csv into your worksheet.

Use Execute Workflow and the Form Test URL. Keep the workflow inactive until a successful end-to-end test.

## 2. Connect OpenAI
Select your OpenAI credential in the HTTP Request node. No API key is included in this template. JSON output is validated before writing to Sheets. Incomplete responses stop the execution. A failed API request may retry once and incur additional usage.

This template uses the OpenAI API through the standard HTTP Request node.

## 3. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail
Use the supplied exact headers. Connect your own credentials in both nodes. The email is plain text. Review dates are recorded only; no scheduled reminder is created.

If Gmail fails after Sheets succeeds, retry only Gmail. Re-running the full workflow appends another row.

Draft: static checks only; run an end-to-end test in your n8n instance before submitting for publication.
